summary.en-US: Warns you before a page loads when its domain uses look-alike characters, such as аmazon.com written with a Cyrillic а. Everything is checked locally; nothing is sent anywhere.
summary.ja: аmazon.com（先頭がキリル文字の а）のように、見た目が紛らわしい文字を使ったドメインを、ページを読み込む前に警告します。判定はすべて端末内で行い、外部には何も送りません。

description.en-US:
Some domain names look exactly like familiar ones but use characters from other scripts. For example, аmazon.com starts with the Cyrillic letter а (U+0430), so it is a different site from amazon.com.

URL Homoglyph Guard checks the domain of every page before it starts loading. When the domain is deceptive, it shows a warning page instead, explaining which character is different and what it looks like. You can go back, or open the site anyway; the exception lasts until you close the browser.

What it detects (based on Unicode Technical Standard #39):
- Domains that look like plain ASCII but contain other characters (аmazon.com, аррӏе.com written entirely in Cyrillic, gοοgle.com with Greek omicrons)
- Domains that mix writing systems in unusual ways (for example Latin with Cyrillic)
- Domains that look like ASCII once accents and other small marks are removed (amazọn.com). This also matches legitimate domains such as münchen.de, so it can be turned off in the settings.

Privacy: all checks run locally. The extension does not read page content and does not send any data anywhere.

Note: Firefox does not run extensions in private windows by default. Allow it in the Add-ons Manager to get warnings there too.
description.ja:
見慣れたドメインとまったく同じに見えても、別の文字体系の文字を使っているドメインがあります。たとえば аmazon.com の先頭はキリル文字の а（U+0430）で、amazon.com とは別のサイトです。

URL Homoglyph Guard は、ページの読み込みが始まる前にドメインを確認します。紛らわしいドメインなら代わりに警告ページを表示し、どの文字が違うのか、何に似ているのかを説明します。戻ることも、そのまま開くこともできます。開くことを選んだドメインは、ブラウザを閉じるまで警告しません。

検出するもの（Unicode Technical Standard #39 に基づく）:
- ASCII に見えるのに別の文字を含むドメイン（аmazon.com、すべてキリル文字で書いた аррӏе.com、ギリシャ文字のオミクロンを使った gοοgle.com）
- 文字体系が不自然に混ざったドメイン（ラテン文字とキリル文字など）
- アクセントなどの小さな記号を除くと ASCII に見えるドメイン（amazọn.com）。münchen.de のような正規のドメインも対象になるため、設定で無効にできます。

プライバシー: 判定はすべて端末内で行います。ページの内容は読まず、外部には何も送りません。

注意: Firefox は既定ではプライベートウィンドウで拡張機能を動かしません。プライベートウィンドウでも警告するには、アドオンの管理画面で許可してください。

version.approval_notes:
Why the permissions are needed:
- webRequest + webRequestBlocking + <all_urls> host permission: a blocking webRequest.onBeforeRequest listener (types: main_frame only) inspects the hostname before a page loads. Only hostnames containing "xn--" (IDNs) are analyzed; if the domain is deceptive, the request is redirected to the bundled warning page (warning/warning.html, listed in web_accessible_resources for that reason). Nothing else is read or modified.
- storage: storage.session keeps per-session exceptions and one-time tokens for the warning page; storage.local keeps one setting.
No data is collected or transmitted (data_collection_permissions: none).

Generated files: extension/data/confusables.js, names.js and scripts.js are generated by tools/build_data.py (Python 3, standard library only) from the bundled Unicode 18.0.0 data files in data/unicode/. To reproduce: run `python tools/build_data.py` in the submitted source; the extension/ directory is then identical to the package. No minifier, bundler or transpiler is used.

How to test: open http://аmazon.test/ (the first letter is Cyrillic U+0430; .test is a reserved TLD, so nothing is contacted). The warning page should appear. Open "Details" to see the character table and the "Accept the risk and open" button.
